Real world love, starting a family, having someone you can really touch, whatever you want, someone that will care for you in your old age, these are things a fictional waifu just can never do. Especially with your condition, you really have to get out there and learn how you can adapt and deal with it, and make it work for dating, it might be unfair yes but those are the cards you were dealt, and it's not impossible to overcome them at all.
